info.title: DogeOS Partner Eligibility API
info.description: Partner-server endpoint for External Rule quests. Marks eligibility; the player still verifies in Questing. Smart Contract Event quests do not use this endpoint. Reviewed against Quest API staging source 6d1cbbd884d22c83746162fb0bb1a4a194f8e783 on 2026-10-29. See api-reference.md for the full behavior and going-live.md before switching to production.

servers.description: Staging; use staging keys and quest IDs
Production; confirm production setup with DogeOS before use

tags.name: External Rule
tags.description: Signal eligibility from the partner backend.

post.summary: Mark a wallet eligible to verify an External Rule quest
post.description: The key and quest must belong to the same partner in the same environment. Repeated signals upsert the same quest-wallet record, refresh its timestamp, and replace metadata. The general eligibility record has no expiry check and is not consumed by verification; coordinate recurring-action requirements with DogeOS. Keep API keys server-side.

parameters.name: questId
parameters.description: UUID of an existing, non-deleted external_rule quest owned by your partner.

200.description: Eligibility recorded. This does not confirm quest completion or reward delivery.

400.description: Request parsing failed, for example an invalid quest UUID or malformed JSON. May be plain text.

415.description: Unsupported or missing application/json content type. May be plain text.

422.description: Handler validation failure, including missing/revoked API key, invalid wallet, missing quest, partner mismatch, unsupported quest type, or reserved native-app evidence. A request-body type error may instead return plain text.

default.description: Other infrastructure or server failure. Check status and content type; do not assume a JSON error envelope.

PartnerApiKey.name: X-Partner-API-Key
PartnerApiKey.description: Raw partner key generated in the matching environment. Never expose it to the browser.

walletAddress.description: EVM address with lowercase 0x prefix and 40 hex characters. Surrounding whitespace is accepted and trimmed; the address is stored lowercase.

metadata.description: Optional audit context; use an object. The current backend accepts any JSON value. Omitted or null becomes an empty object; repeated signals replace existing metadata. The nativeAppEvidence field is reserved for the separately configured MyDoge integration.

message.description: Handler error prefixed with Validation error: . See api-reference.md for messages.
